title: Emote View [Old Ver]
description: A performance focused Emotecraft addon that automatically stops distant player emotes based on a configurable distance.
body:
**Emotes View** is a performance-focused addon for Emotecraft that automatically stops emotes from players who are too far away. This helps reduce unnecessary rendering and improves overall client performance, especially in crowded servers.

Command Usage:

```
/lkgemotes distance <value>
```
<value> = The maximum distance (in blocks) where emotes will still play
Players beyond this distance will have their emotes automatically stopped

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/395013e29edc4a28073bc590032f071a99fff642.gif)
